Standard: Air vehicle and store allowable mixed loadout combinations and their associated carriage and release limitations are defined for the safe carriage, operation, and release of stores. This includes information published in (or supplemental to) store loadout and air vehicle configuration manuals and electronic tools (e.g., mission planning) that dictate which stores are authorized on the air vehicle for a given loadout or mission. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Verify that all approved air vehicle store loadout combinations and their associated carriage and release limitations are derived from store compatibility engineering source data and documented in technical data. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Examination.
(2) Verify approved store loadout combinations and applicable limitations and procedures have been validated and verified by the appropriate technical authority and are documented in USG verified flight manual(s) or equivalent supplement(s).
(3) Verify that all electronic tools supporting store loadout and limitations are verified and comply with the USG verified technical documents.
